title: 2.13 More Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Name brown, pink, purple and gray, and use muy: La casa es muy grande.
grammar_function: El/La + noun + es (muy) + adjective; café and rosa never change for la.
speaking_outcome: Say more colors and how big things are.
